title: MENU INFO PAGES
intro: {b}Welcome to MenuInfoPages!{/} This generated example shows the main features available in version 1.3.0. Use it as a starting point for guides, rules, help pages and server information.
_imagesNote: Images may use a PNG filename from mods/MenuInfoPages/images/ (for example logo.png), the optional images/logo.png alias, an existing UI asset path, or a direct http(s) PNG URL. Local and remote external images use the live-reload behavior configured in reload.yml. Recommended max width: 700px.

sections.text: Text supports {b}bold{/}, {i}italic{/}, {m}monospace{/} and {#54daf4}hex colors{/}. Use {/} to close the most recently opened format.

sections.title: SECTIONS AND BUTTONS
sections.text: A page supports up to five top images, five sections and five bottom action buttons. Buttons can run commands as the player or console, use primary/secondary/danger styles, or simply close the page.

footer: Edit example.json or create a new page with /infopages newpage. Press Esc to close.
